summary: When voice admission is closed, Flutter now keeps the same roster-state header subtitle as web instead of replacing it with the admission restriction. A test-first regression reproduces the header mismatch and passes after the fix; body presentation is covered separately by QA-171.

After implementation, the widget test passes for loading, unavailable, empty, populated, and unavailable-in-closed-channel states.
